candidates.name: KML Standard
verified_facts: KML is an XML language focused on geographic visualization, annotation and display in earth browsers.
It can encode points, lines, polygons and presentation/navigation information.
semantic_limits: KML portrayal geometry is not evidence of exact HMLR legal boundaries, LiDAR source resolution or terrain elevation accuracy.

candidates.name: GML in JPEG 2000 for Geographic Imagery Standard
verified_facts: GMLJP2 defines mechanisms for embedding GML geospatial information within JPEG 2000 imagery.
It provides packaging and application-schema mechanisms for geographic imagery.
semantic_limits: Georeferenced imagery packaging does not certify raw elevation values, bare-earth semantics, vertical datum or source survey accuracy.
